about.title: Online learning, made more intentional.
about.description: Thinkers brings trustworthy instructors, well-structured content, and measurable progress together in one focused learning platform.
about.purposeText: We believe online learning works best when the path is clear. Thinkers gives learners a calm place to build useful skills and gives instructors professional tools to teach them well.

values.title: Progress you can see
values.description: Built-in tracking shows learners what they have achieved and what comes next.

why.title: A better environment for serious learning.
why.description: Everything is designed to make online learning clearer, more credible, and easier to continue.

items.title: Quality you can trust
items.description: Every published course follows a clear review process before reaching learners.

items.title: Learn from practitioners
items.description: Approved instructors transform real experience into focused, practical curricula.

items.title: Progress that stays visible
items.description: Track lesson completion, assessments, and milestones without losing momentum.

features.title: Everything you need to learn, practice, and prove your progress.
features.description: Six thoughtfully connected capabilities turn every course into an active, measurable learning journey.

items.title: AI Tutor
items.description: Ask questions in context, unpack difficult concepts, summarize lessons, and keep moving without leaving your course.

items.title: Interactive courses
items.description: Follow structured curricula with focused lessons, practical resources, assessments, notes, and bookmarks.

items.title: Video learning
items.description: Learn through a distraction-free player with saved position, lesson navigation, and completion tracking.

items.title: Gamification
items.description: Build momentum with XP, learner levels, daily streaks, achievements, and a privacy-first leaderboard.

items.title: Verified certificates
items.description: Earn a professional, downloadable certificate with a public verification code when every requirement is complete.

items.title: Progress analytics
items.description: See completion, remaining lessons, recent activity, and the next best learning action at a glance.
